decisions.decision: The commission decided to add GEO caching into section 1.2 to clearly identify it as an allowed activity.

decisions.decision: Geocaching and letterboxing to be inserted in section 2.2.
decisions.quote: after examining section 2.2 , geo caching and letter boxing would be inserted in section 2.2.

decisions.decision: Section 2.5 to state that any organized activity must appear before the commission.
decisions.quote: the commission agreed to add into section 2.5 that any organized activity must appear before the commission.

decisions.decision: The invasive plant list to be kept as a general reference to the state list, not specified.

decisions.decision: Bow hunting to be stated as allowed on all conservation lands by right, in conformance with state regulations; commission agreed.
